messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Nguyen <timothy.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action required: short-cycle stage & close-date reconciliation for Q4 forecast

Team —

Quick hygiene ask to keep Finance’s Q4 numbers sane: we need a short-cycle sweep of all opportunities closing in Oct–Dec and an explicit update to either (a) confirmed close date, (b) move to next fiscal quarter, or (c) change stage to "Hold / Nurture" with a brief rationale. Finance will lock the forecast on Friday 10/09; please complete updates by EOD Thursday 10/08.

Scope & instructions (short):
- Run a micro-sweep for deals in Commit/Best Case/Commit-Review with close dates in Q4.
- If there’s active procurement (PO, SOW being reviewed), update close date to the latest negotiated week and add the procurement status in the Salesforce Notes field.
- If customer activity has stalled for >30 days, move to "Hold / Nurture" and select a reason from the dropdown (budget / timing / technical blocker).
- Tag high-dollar deals (> $100k ARR) that are at risk with a follow-up action and owner in the Opportunity Chatter thread.

I attached a simple template (Q4-pipeline-hygiene-template.xlsx) if you prefer to export, triage offline, and re-import. Also drop any contentious/opportunity-specific asks into the shared Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Gq-Pipeline-Hygiene.

Why this matters: Finance needs a defensible commit line for board reporting and our Cadence forecast. A few stale close dates have artificially inflated commit this month. We want confidence without blocking good deals.

Please reply here with any clarifying questions — I’ll do a quick read on Thursday morning and escalate any outliers to Sales Leadership.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4-pipeline-hygiene-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets: summary + ops)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 9:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Quick hygiene ask to keep Finance’s Q4 numbers sane...

Got it — will run across my book today. Two quick clarifying q's:
1) For "Commit-Review" opportunities where legal is reviewing contract language but AE has verbal confirmation, do we treat as Commit (keep date) or move to Commit-Review with a one-week buffer?
2) For pipeline where procurement has asked for additional security docs (SOC2 evidence), do we want owners to update close-date or instead tag as "Procurement - docs pending" and leave the date?

My inclination: keep close-date if we have a documented verbal confirmation + PO window, otherwise do a one-week conservative push and add the reason. For SOC2/doc asks I lean toward keeping existing date but flag in Notes and set an active follow-up action. Happy to align if Finance wants a stricter rule.

I'll push an initial list back by 3pm today.

—Laura
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action required: short-cycle stage & close-date reconciliation for Q4 forecast

Thanks Dylan — I ran a micro-sweep across my 12 active opps. Quick summary (pulled into the template attached):
- 3 deals: keep close-date (verbal confirmation + procurement timeline set)
- 4 deals: push +1 to +3 weeks (internal approvals pending)
- 5 deals: move to Hold / Nurture (no activity >45 days)

I attached a CSV extract (deal-list.csv) with SFIDs, current stage, owner, and recommended action. I also added comments on the largest two deals (ACME-2583 and BETA-4120) with the key blocker for each.

I agree with Laura on SOC2/doc asks — flag in notes and keep date if customer has sign-off timeline. If Procurement explicitly requests a formal extension, we push the date.

I will update the Opportunity Notes with the procurement status and tag owners for follow-up.

—Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
